model_output.rationale: Both lines carry CO-29. The Oct 2025 re-submission (837P dated 2025-10-15) was filed ~9 months post-DOS and exceeded the payer's commercial window. But the 277CA (ACK75364521, received 2025-01-27) shows an original claim accepted for adjudication just 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS — timely under any commercial limit. Per 03-timely-filing.md, a clearinghouse acceptance report stops the clock. N211 is a Medicare RARC misapplied to a CI claim; commercial appeal rights stand.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 fired on the Oct 2025 re-submission (~9 months post-DOS). Original claim was received 2025-01-27 per 277CA A2 acceptance — 8 days post-DOS, timely under any commercial limit. Filing clock stopped at that original payer receipt.

next_action.detail: Appeal with 277CA (ACK75364521, 2025-01-27, status A2) as proof of timely original receipt. Dispute the receipt date; do not plead hardship. N211 is a Medicare-specific RARC misapplied to this CI claim; commercial appeal rights are unaffected.

evidence.fact: Lines 1–2 both CO-29 ($91.91 + $46.71 = $138.62), MOA N211 — timely filing expired, claim-level no-appeal remark
